# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

I believe that understanding design will help me communicate better with designers and developers, which in turn will have a positive impact on project performance. In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

# Resume

Remote / Part-time / Product Owner / Product Manager / Project Manager
Years of experience: 5
English level: upper

Big Four Enterprise experience for recent 8+ months (T&M)

 Up to 6 projects simultaneously with 60+ FTEs (mostly distributed)

 $4.7M yearly revenue (gain of $700K for recent 8 months)

 APM of 60-80%, NPS of 70-90%, eNPS of 60-80%

 2 startup projects from scratch to MVP (e-commerce/HoReCa and e-commerce/education)

 1 BI e-commerce/travel project from MVP to MMP (70+ Customers/Stakeholders, 30+ applications, 3 servers, legacy code, QlikView)

 80% TM vs 20% FP contracts

 Switched career 2 times until finally discovered myself
Has 5+ years of experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst and Product Owner/Manager. Hands on experience in 2 startups, product and outsourcing companies, huge enterprise. US/EU/UA based customers. Experienced SCRUM follower, building cross-functional, distributed Scrum teams. Critical voice in the decision process and the leadership of the product. Influencer for technical decisions. Strong ability for discovering and understanding true problems and pains of  Customers/Stakeholders. Leading by example, inspiring others for new achievements. Excellent communicator with Dev Teams and Customers/Stakeholders with/for new ideas. Great balancer between New features, Change requests, Investigations, Technical debts and Refactoring. Lifelong  learner (CSPO certified; PMI®PMP, BA, QC, Java – trainings, courses). Strong at Tough Decision Making. Problem solver (both analytical and creative capabilities). Tendency to Kaizen, UI/UX perfectionist. Career switcher. 9+ years in IT.



Absolutely self motivated leader who will drive the product and team to the best possible future. Strongly focused on problems and causes, and may assure that best decisions will be made. In case of other unexpected and not managed  risks = situational management with transparent communication (CPO, PMO, CR Board, Customers, Stakeholders). May lack some technical background, but fast learning capabilities, common sense and true passion of what I do, is really filling that gap quickly.
Not healthcare and life science

 Remote

 Part-time job ~ 20h per week

 Availability: till 11am and starting 6pm EEST

 Any responsibilities within Product and IT Project Management as long as it is fits available timeframes

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

I believe that understanding design will help me communicate better with designers and developers, which in turn will have a positive impact on project performance. In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

# Resume

Delivery Manager, Project Manager, Scrum master
Years of experience: 4
English level: fluent

Achievements:

- Released a major medical software release, while managing a team of 11 people

- Mentored a junior PM

- Completed the "Project Management" course from

"Geekhub", finished the project first while meeting the project goals

- Implemented Scrum methodology in one of the companies

- Participated in an internal course about coaching and communication

- Implemented processes into internal company routine

- Managed a team that consisted of 18 people within different projects

- Finished multiple projects within discussed timeframe
Can speak and write in English freely. I'm up to a test, so you can start a conversation in English if you'd like. More practice = more skill



I am a result-oriented project manager with 4 years of experience. A fast and eager learner, I am detail oriented and used to adapting to changing project requirements to meet business goals.



I've worked in healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and gaming domains, etc 

My teams built web, mobile, and desktop applications



Worked with CRMs like Jira and Redmine

Worked with CMSs like OpenCart, WordPress



My responsibilities throughout my career were:

- Coaching teams to achieve business goals

- Project delivery control

- Processes implementation to the team`s workflow

- Team workflow optimization

- People management

- Auxiliary functions such as time-track control, -performance reviews, conducting interviews, etc.

- Projects flow control

- Presales

- Project budget management

- Project estimation

- Design requirements specification

- Wireframing

- Requirements specification

- Requirements gathering

- Technical specification writing

- Mentoring, coaching



I'm the guy you need, so, don't waste any time, and let's have a chat.
1. I want to have an opportunity to learn and deepen my knowledge in management.

2. I want to be sure to work for a long period of time (2 year+). This way the project gets done, knowledge achieved, and feedback received.

3. Financial reward is always a good stimulus to work

4. I need a short feedback loop in order to learn more efficiently

Years of experience: 11
English level: fluent

Looking for an opportunity to work as part of a strong team of like-minded individuals on a meaningful and innovative product, following modern DevOps principles and approaches.



Do not offer support positions for legacy on-prem projects, DBA or Windows stack

Python Developer
Years of experience: 1
English level: upper

Hello!

I have one year of practical experience as a Python Developer and Data Engineer and over 4 years running my own business.



I build web applications and RESTful APIs using Django and Django REST Framework. I use PostgreSQL, Git, and Docker. I also have experience in FastAP. In my projects, I worked with Telegram Bot API and Celery task frameworks.



My mathematical education and my Pandas, Matplotlib, and SQL knowledge allow me to query and manipulate data effectively to extract valuable insights and approach problems with a logical and analytical mindset. 



Additionally, my experience running my own business has provided me with valuable skills such as project management, client communication, and problem-solving. I am able to work independently or as part of a team and can prioritize tasks to meet deadlines. 



With my Upper Intermediate English proficiency, I can communicate effectively with clients and colleagues from diverse backgrounds.

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

Years of experience: 5
English level: upper

Big Four Enterprise experience for recent 8+ months (T&M)

 Up to 6 projects simultaneously with 60+ FTEs (mostly distributed)

 $4.7M yearly revenue (gain of $700K for recent 8 months)

 APM of 60-80%, NPS of 70-90%, eNPS of 60-80%

 2 startup projects from scratch to MVP (e-commerce/HoReCa and e-commerce/education)

 1 BI e-commerce/travel project from MVP to MMP (70+ Customers/Stakeholders, 30+ applications, 3 servers, legacy code, QlikView)

 80% TM vs 20% FP contracts

 Switched career 2 times until finally discovered myself
Has 5+ years of experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst and Product Owner/Manager. Hands on experience in 2 startups, product and outsourcing companies, huge enterprise. US/EU/UA based customers. Experienced SCRUM follower, building cross-functional, distributed Scrum teams. Critical voice in the decision process and the leadership of the product. Tendency to Kaizen, UI/UX perfectionist. Career switcher. 9+ years in IT.



Absolutely self motivated leader who will drive the product and team to the best possible future. Strongly focused on problems and causes, and may assure that best decisions will be made. In case of other unexpected and not managed  risks = situational management with transparent communication (CPO, PMO, CR Board, Customers, Stakeholders). May lack some technical background, but fast learning capabilities, common sense and true passion of what I do, is really filling that gap quickly.
Not healthcare and life science

 Remote

 Part-time job ~ 20h per week

 Availability: till 11am and starting 6pm EEST

 Any responsibilities within Product and IT Project Management as long as it is fits available timeframes

My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

 Up to 6 projects simultaneously with 60+ FTEs (mostly distributed)

 $4.7M yearly revenue (gain of $700K for recent 8 months)

 APM of 60-80%, NPS of 70-90%, eNPS of 60-80%

 2 startup projects from scratch to MVP (e-commerce/HoReCa and e-commerce/education)

 1 BI e-commerce/travel project from MVP to MMP (70+ Customers/Stakeholders, 30+ applications, 3 servers, legacy code, QlikView)

 80% TM vs 20% FP contracts

 Switched career 2 times until finally discovered myself

Influencer for technical decisions. Strong ability for discovering and understanding true problems and pains of  Customers/Stakeholders. Leading by example, inspiring others for new achievements. Excellent communicator with Dev Teams and Customers/Stakeholders with/for new ideas. Great balancer between New features, Change requests, Investigations, Technical debts and Refactoring. Lifelong  learner (CSPO certified; PMI®PMP, BA, QC, Java – trainings, courses). Strong at Tough Decision Making. Problem solver (both analytical and creative capabilities). Tendency to Kaizen, UI/UX perfectionist. Career switcher. 9+ years in IT.



Absolutely self motivated leader who will drive the product and team to the best possible future. Strongly focused on problems and causes, and may assure that best decisions will be made. In case of other unexpected and not managed  risks = situational management with transparent communication (CPO, PMO, CR Board, Customers, Stakeholders). May lack some technical background, but fast learning capabilities, common sense and true passion of what I do, is really filling that gap quickly.
Not healthcare and life science

 Remote

 Part-time job ~ 20h per week

 Availability: till 11am and starting 6pm EEST

 Any responsibilities within Product and IT Project Management as long as it is fits available timeframes

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

Delivery Manager, Project Manager, Scrum master

Can speak and write in English freely. I'm up to a test, so you can start a conversation in English if you'd like. More practice = more skill

I've worked in healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and gaming domains, etc 

My teams built web, mobile, and desktop applications



Worked with CRMs like Jira and Redmine

Worked with CMSs like OpenCart, WordPress



My responsibilities throughout my career were:

- Coaching teams to achieve business goals

- Project delivery control

- Processes implementation to the team`s workflow

- Team workflow optimization

- People management

- Auxiliary functions such as time-track control, -performance reviews, conducting interviews, etc.

- Projects flow control

- Presales

- Project budget management

- Project estimation

- Design requirements specification

- Wireframing

- Requirements specification

- Requirements gathering

- Technical specification writing

- Mentoring, coaching

3. Financial reward is always a good stimulus to work

4. I need a short feedback loop in order to learn more efficiently

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-201)

# Resume

Senior Python Developer
Years of experience: 5
English level: intermediate

A Python Developer with 3+ years of experience. I specialize in both web and desktop application development. A fast learner with a great work ethic and the ability to work independently or with others.



My primary tool to build the back-end is Python. I'm familiar with many frameworks, such as Flask, FastAPI, Django, etc. I use Vue3 to create a front-end. And Electron to build a cross-platform desktop software. Also, I can manage servers on Unix-based systems, deploy applications, and design PostgreSQL database. 



My code is clear, documented, and covered with tests. I stick to design patterns and SOLID principles to maintain an appropriate level of the codebase. 



I've been working in a British start-up for 2 years. The project provides B2B property and planning search. I'm responsible for many things, including code review, refactoring, writing documentation, implementing new features, deploying, scaling infostructure, designing PostgreSQL database.
Improvement of my professional skills, knowledge, and experience as a software engineer through working in a team - those things are very important to me working in your company.

 $4.7M yearly revenue (gain of $700K for recent 8 months)

 80% TM vs 20% FP contracts

Absolutely self motivated leader who will drive the product and team to the best possible future. Strongly focused on problems and causes, and may assure that best decisions will be made. Not healthcare and life science

 Remote

 Part-time job ~ 20h per week

 Availability: till 11am and starting 6pm EEST

 Any responsibilities within Product and IT Project Management as long as it is fits available timeframes

Currently, I learn English. I'd like to continue working as AQA Engineer.



More details are in my CV.

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-208)

Now the main thing for me is to practice and gain experience, so I am always happy to share my knowledge and absorb interesting design solutions from my colleagues to pump up their technical skills.



I will be glad to talk to you! :)
Professional and personal growth encouraging; Ability to work sometimes remotely.

# Resume

Project Manager
Years of experience: 3
English level: intermediate

-Thanks to the efficient use of limited resources, I successfully carried out the renovation of a Ukrainian bank, leading to impressive results.



-I dedicate my time and effort to creating an informative Telegram channel that will serve as a valuable source of knowledge on management.
Hi to all. My name is Nazar, I am 26 years old.

I have more than three years of work experience in the field of management, in particular in project management. The last year I worked in the field of IT management. I have experience in projects of various complexity and size.



One of my most significant projects was related to the creation of a new website for one of the Ukrainian banks. I performed the role of project manager, responsible for planning and control of tasks, allocation of resources, communication with the team, as well as the customer of the project. We successfully completed the project on time and within budget, which ensured positive feedback from the customer.



I currently hold the position of project manager and am responsible for managing projects, ensuring communication between the team and the customer, planning and controlling the execution of tasks, organizing work processes, maintaining documentation and ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget.
IIn my future projects, I would like to deepen my knowledge in game creation by focusing on the design department. I believe that understanding design will help me communicate better with designers and developers, which in turn will have a positive impact on project performance. In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

# Resume

Java Developer
Years of experience: 4
English level: intermediate

Successfully developing and implementing various Java projects in different areas, such as web development, mobile applications, software development, and others.



Increasing their level of qualification and professional skills through various online courses, certifications, and other training programs.



Making a significant contribution to the development of large and complex projects based on Java, such as developing project architecture and optimizing its performance.



Participating in various technical conferences, speaking as a presenter, and actively participating in open communities of Java developers.
Skilled Java Developer with 3+ years of experience in creating dynamic web applications. Updates functionality based on customer requirements to ensure excellent user experience. Initiative, able to work without constant supervision.

Skils:

- Java 8, 11, 17

- PostgreSQL, MS SQL, MongoDb

- Spring (Boot, MVC, Data, Security, WebSockets, Reactive)

- Gitlab, Git, Maven

- HTML, CSS, JS, JQuery, JSP, Bootstrap, Thymeleaf, Primefaces

- Junit, Mockito

- Docker, REST API, Swagger, RabbitMQ

- JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue

- Ubuntu, Azure, IntelliJ IDEA, Net Beans

- English level: Intermediate.

Projects: 

1. Enterprise resource planning (ERP) for grain stock management - developed a system for managing production business processes, traffic management, production planning, quantitative and qualitative warehouse accounting. 

Participated: 

System design for ERP planning and stock management;

REST API for document exchange service on Spring Boot;

Truck traffic management and device management;

WSO2 and Rabbit MQ integration.

Tools/Technologies: PostgreSQL, MS Azure, Git, Docker, Bash, Java 11,  Java EE, Primefaces, Vue.

Learning and development opportunities: The candidate may expect to receive opportunities to learn new technologies and expand their professional skills on the job.



Supportive team environment: The candidate may expect to work in a friendly and supportive team environment that fosters collaboration and mutual support among colleagues.



Competitive salary: The candidate may expect to receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with their professional experience and skills.



Flexible schedule: The candidate may expect to work in an environment that provides flexibility in their work schedule, allowing them to be productive and maintain a healthy work-life balance.



Career development: The candidate may expect to receive opportunities for career development and advancement within the field of software development.

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-201)

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-201)

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 1
English level: upper

Hello!

I have one year of practical experience as a Python Developer and Data Engineer and over 4 years running my own business.



I build web applications and RESTful APIs using Django and Django REST Framework. I use PostgreSQL, Git, and Docker. I also have experience in FastAP. In my projects, I worked with Telegram Bot API and Celery task frameworks.



My mathematical education and my Pandas, Matplotlib, and SQL knowledge allow me to query and manipulate data effectively to extract valuable insights and approach problems with a logical and analytical mindset. 



Additionally, my experience running my own business has provided me with valuable skills such as project management, client communication, and problem-solving. I am able to work independently or as part of a team and can prioritize tasks to meet deadlines. 



With my Upper Intermediate English proficiency, I can communicate effectively with clients and colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-201)

scoring.rationale: The candidate fails to meet three mandatory requirements: they have only one year of Python experience instead of the required four, lack MS SQL experience (using PostgreSQL instead), and do not demonstrate cloud application development. While they show some ability to design Python applications, the critical gaps in experience duration and specific technology stacks disqualify them from a strong or potential match.

criteria.requirement: At least 4 years of professional experience with Python.
criteria.reasoning: The candidate explicitly states they have 'one year of practical experience' with Python, which directly contradicts the mandatory requirement of at least 4 years. The resume does not provide any evidence of professional Python experience spanning four years or more.
criteria.evidence: "Python Developer with one year of practical experience"

criteria.requirement: Experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL).
criteria.reasoning: The candidate lists PostgreSQL as a technical skill but has no mention of Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL) anywhere in the resume. The rubric requires MS SQL experience, and using PostgreSQL does not satisfy this specific requirement.

criteria.requirement: Experience developing cloud applications using cloud technologies.
criteria.reasoning: While the candidate mentions Docker in their skills, they lack explicit evidence of developing cloud applications using broader cloud technologies (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP). The resume only lists containerization tools without confirming cloud application development experience.

criteria.requirement: Ability to design Python-based applications or solutions

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.

 - authorization

 - marketing events system

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-208)

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Senior Data Scientist
Years of experience: 6
English level: intermediate

Data Science engineer with good software development skills and practical experience in leading and management.



Have strong deep learning/machine learning knowledge and server-side web development/deployment experience. Worked with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras frameworks, and general ML libraries – scikit-learn, scipy, pandas, openCV, xgboost, NLTK, SpaCy, etc. 



Knowledgeable in web development, deployment, and cloud-technologies usages (AWS/GCP). Experienced in data engineering (ELK stack).



Have practical experience in mentoring, team leading, requirements collection, project management, change management, and expertise in analyzing and altering processes to ensure efciency.
Most interested in Data Science projects, additions of Data Engineering and/or Python development would be happily accepted.

Open to positions with responsibilities in mentoring, team leading, project management and pre-sale process, as well as client interaction.



Projects without DS or with little DS work are not relevant.
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-203)

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)
Pre-Screening Compliance Note (DJ-208)

In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

# Resume

Junior UI/UX Designer
Years of experience: 0
English level: pre

I completed three pet projects (design for a landing page, redesign, and a team project - a web service) With each completed project, I gained important experience and improved my hard and soft skills, and working on a team project helped me develop time management and improve my communication skills. The ability to conduct research and analyze competitors using Similarweb, which helps me understand which solutions are best to use. Continuous development of watchfulness and design thinking
Hi, I'm a young and energetic UX/UI designer, I love what I do, I'm always looking to improve my skills, and adapt to new technologies and I'm open to new experiences. I work with such programs as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Figma. I already have such works in my portfolio:

Pet-project

Landing Page for a Barbershop

The full cycle of creating a landing page design for a barber shop for men in Kyiv. The objective was to create a minimalist design with a dark background and easy navigation that could capture the attention of potential customers without any specific additional requirements. Before starting, the project, thorough research, competitor analysis, prototyping, UI design, and final product presentation preparation were conducted;



Redesign and adapt a tattoo studio website.

The previous design looked outdated and not very convenient, which prevented a potential client from finding a solution to his appeal. Therefore, the goal of the project was to create a modern and convenient design that could improve the attraction of new customers while maintaining recognition among existing ones. Full cycle of creating. Before the start, was conducted research and analysis of competitors were carried out this helped to understand what successful solutions to use Preparation of ideas for future redesign, creation of prototypes, UI design development, adaptation, and final product presentation;



Design of a web service for finding lost pets

This project was a team effort that brought me new experiences and improved my communication skills. Before starting the work, there was research and analysis of competitors, formulation of the JTBD table, user flow, CJM, and finally prototyping. The goal was to make a light and bright design so that users would feel calm and hopeful. The full cycle of creation. We made a convenient navigation, a block with a map and marks to help speed up the search, a chat with another user for convenient communication already on the site, etc. Adaptation to tablet and phone devices, preparation for the presentation of the final product
I am an open and sincere person, so I will be very happy to have a friendly team, with experienced professionals or beginners, with creative thinking and enthusiasm for their work, to work with you to create incredible products that are both functional and commercially successful.

(I am not interested in employment in russian companies or companies cooperating with them)
